paraphrase: Hear the ways of worship: some worship holding books; some set up lamps and worship for fame; some worship with a woman; some worship the cakra; our worship is like the Meru — the Siddhars worship setting up the forty-three triangles.

paraphrase: After the five initiations, place the prāṇa in the yoga called vāci; for one who knows all these there are no obstacles to perfecting the body (kāya-citti); whatever the Siddhars left unsaid, this supplies.

paraphrase: Men of many lands waver; when will the mind become straight? Crores in the world are troubled; dying and being born go to and fro like a carrying-pole; troubled by sorrow, their wisdom is gone.

original.text: तियङ्गिऩाल् कॆर्सित्तुत् तुरत्तुच् चण्णुञ् / जीऱियर् मिलेच्चरैये सुगत्ति ऩ्ळ्ळे / मयङ्गिऩार् नालुबा तत्ति ऩुळ्ळुम् / मऩञ्जॆव्वै यावदॆप्पो तऱिवदॆप्पो ? / तयङ्गिऩार् उलगत्तिऱ् कोडि पेर्गळ् / सावदुम् पिऱप्पदुङ्गा वडिबो लाच्चु / तुयङ्गिऩार् तुयरत्ताल् ञाऩम् पोच्चु / सुडुगाट्टिल् अऱिवदुबोल् सुत्तप् पाऴे।
